commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' 0 - 5 It's in the back of the net! Allan Saint-Maximin sprays a pass out to Rayan Fofana (Lens), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:5.
90+1' Pierre Sage decides to make a substitution. Matthieu Udol will be replaced by Arthur Masuaku (Lens).

73' Stephane Gilli has decided to substitute Marshall Munetsi and he is replaced by Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC).

72' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lens comes to nothing.
69' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Odsonne Edouard as he is replaced by Rayan Fofana (Lens).
68' Pierre Sage has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Allan Saint-Maximin (Lens) replacing Wesley Said.
65' Paris FC are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

62' Matthieu Udol (Lens) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Paris FC.
62' The offside statistics – 0:5.

58' Florian Thauvin (Lens) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
57' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul after Otavio (Paris FC) hacks down one of his opponents. Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to Lens!
56' Great teamplay by Paris FC as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

47' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
46' The whistle blows and Bastien Dechepy starts the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+4' Wesley Said (Lens) picked up a yellow card from referee.
45+3' A corner kick by Lens is thwarted by the well prepared Kevin Trapp (Paris FC).
45+1' Lens can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

42' The Lens players are exchanging some short passes.
40' 3:5 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.

37' Rudy Matondo (Paris FC) is able to continue to play.

35' Rudy Matondo (Paris FC) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

31' Wesley Said (Lens) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
30' The Lens players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
27' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) has a goal ruled out for offside!
27' Paris FC seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
25' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:5.

23' Ciro Immobile (Paris FC) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
21' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Paris FC.
19' Neat passing move from Paris FC in order to create new attacking opportunities.
15' Paris FC have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
14' Paris FC control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
13' What a big chance! Odsonne Edouard (Lens) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Paris FC will have a goal kick.
12' Wesley Said (Lens) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
10' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
10' 59:41 – the latest ball possession ratio.
9' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
9' Looks like Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
8' Florian Thauvin (Lens) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!

7' He should have scored! Marshall Munetsi (Paris FC) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Robin Risser makes an easy save.
6' The ball is cleared after Florian Thauvin (Lens) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
5' Nhoa Sangui (Paris FC) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
4' Paris FC enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
2' The Lens players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
